promises.reason: The corrected retained-OpenMaus decision governs both design and digest-bound tasks. The design requires actual source/version and assignment/result/control/recovery seams before a supported adapter or bounded host delta can become a Q1 proposal, and explicitly permits a missing-seam HOLD. No installed bridge, live bot or reviewer account is enrolled.
